scope: Major codec/container families, not an exhaustive list of VLC profiles. Plugin presence is not proof of playback.
vlcReference: Installed VLC3.0.23 and VideoLAN feature documentation

entries.name: PCM WAVE
entries.coverage: Integer 8/16/24/32-bit input; normalized to16-bit output.

entries.name: G.711 A-law / μ-law
entries.coverage: WAVE carriers; known sample-value tests.

entries.name: IMA ADPCM
entries.coverage: Mono/stereo WAVE blocks; no generic ADPCM-family claim.

entries.name: FLAC
entries.coverage: Original full-file native fLaC decoder, with fixed/LPC/Rice/stereo/checksum checks. Matroska FLAC uses original frame handling and macOS decoding; native MOV/PCM sample counts tested.

entries.name: RGB AVI
entries.coverage: Uncompressed24/32-bit frames; video only.

entries.name: RLE8 AVI
entries.coverage: Complete palette keyframes only; no delta/partial frames. Video only.

entries.name: Baseline MJPEG AVI
entries.coverage: Original8-bit sequential Huffman JPEG; explicit tables required. No progressive, arithmetic, missing-DHT or interlaced fields. Video only.

entries.name: H.264 / AVC in MP4/MOV
entries.coverage: Compatible local files use macOS decoding; not an independently written H.264 decoder.

entries.name: Matroska AVC / HEVC and audio
entries.coverage: Original demux/remux with macOS decoding. Tested AVC/HEVC Main10, alternate audio, AAC-LC/HE-AAC, MP3/FLAC/PCM, limited Opus, original text and PGS bitmap subtitles. Reordered video needs a complete CFR timeline; ASS styling remains limited.

entries.name: HEVC / H.265
entries.coverage: Matroska and compatible MOV/MP4 use macOS decoding. Native 8/10-bit fixtures and a Main10 1080p file tested. Hardware, profile and carrier limits still apply; no independent HEVC decoder.

entries.name: ProRes
entries.coverage: Six standard ProRes profiles in MOV passed native pixel decode, seek comparison and actual player output. Generated 8-bit source only: no original ProRes decoder, RAW, high-bit-depth/alpha conformance or Matroska claim.

entries.name: JPEG2000
entries.coverage: No independently implemented decoder or verified playback route in this build.

entries.name: Cinepak / Indeo
entries.coverage: No independently implemented decoder or verified playback route. Microsoft Video 1 is now tracked separately.

entries.name: MP3
entries.coverage: macOS decoding, including original Matroska framing. Native synthetic MP3-to-MOV-to-PCM roundtrip tested. Free-format MP3 is not implemented.

entries.name: AAC
entries.coverage: Delegated to macOS where playable; codec/profile coverage is not exhaustively verified.

entries.name: ALAC
entries.coverage: Delegated to macOS where playable; codec/profile coverage is not exhaustively verified.

entries.name: AIFF / CAF
entries.coverage: Delegated to macOS where playable; codec/profile coverage is not exhaustively verified.

entries.name: AC-3 / E-AC-3
entries.coverage: Original AC-3/E-AC-3 header framing and Matroska pass-through to macOS. Header/timing checks pass; full payload playback remains unverified. Dependent E-AC-3 substreams are rejected.

entries.name: DTS / DTS-HD

entries.name: Opus
entries.coverage: Matroska Opus mapping family 0, mono/stereo with macOS decoding. Original header/TOC framing, pre-skip, positive tail padding and seek roll metadata; exact native sample counts and seeking tested. Nonzero header gain and other mapping families remain unsupported.

entries.name: SRT / WebVTT
entries.coverage: Original external UTF-8 SRT/VTT and embedded Matroska UTF-8/WebVTT text rendering and timing. System embedded tracks remain selectable.

entries.name: ASS / SSA
entries.coverage: Embedded Matroska ASS/SSA readable text, track selection and timing. Advanced fonts, positioning, styling, karaoke and drawings remain unsupported.

entries.name: VobSub / DVB subtitles
entries.coverage: No independent renderer in this build. PGS is tracked separately.

entries.name: H.263 in MOV
entries.coverage: Native MOV fixture passed pixel decode/seek comparison and actual player output. No MPEG-4 ASP, arbitrary carrier/profile or independently written H.263 decoder claim.

entries.name: Microsoft Video 1 AVI
entries.coverage: Original 8-bit indexed / 16-bit RGB555 solid, two/eight-color and delta blocks, with exact random/concurrent AVI seeks. Video only; dimensions must be multiples of four. Dynamic AVI palette chunks, partial edges and top-down storage remain unsupported.

entries.name: Microsoft ADPCM WAVE
entries.coverage: Original WAVE tag 2 mono/stereo decoding with custom coefficient tables, clipping, fact trimming and complete-header partial final blocks. Exact sample goldens, native reference prefixes and actual player transport tested.

entries.name: PGS bitmap subtitles
entries.coverage: Original bounded PGS palette, fragmented object, RLE, composition, crop/window and clear handling. Matroska bitmap track selection, placement, seeking, delay and resizing tested. Blu-ray demux/PES, 3D, HDR extensions and other bitmap formats remain unsupported.
